title: CLAUDE.md profile says the repository is private; it is public
description: The repository profile in CLAUDE.md says the repository is private for now. gh api reads private:false, and the operator directed on 2026-11-01 that Ward be released and made public after the pre-public review (ODOC-552). Correct the line.

acceptanceCriteria.text: The profile line states the repository is public, cites ODOC-552, and says to re-measure

finalSummary: Corrected the profile line in CLAUDE.md: the repository is public (operator direction 2026-11-01, ODOC-552; gh api private:false), with a note to re-measure.
